release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.4 CAD Table Splitting, Outward Anchor Callout Offsets & Settings Persistence:
• CAD Drawing Table Auto-Splitting (> 20 Rows): Any schedule table with more than 20 rows (cutting length tables, chair summary tables) automatically splits into side-by-side sub-tables horizontally with clean spacing and repeated column headers. The TOTAL row is placed at the bottom of the final sub-table, and sheet borders expand dynamically to encompass all columns.
• Outward Anchor END VALUE Callout Offsets: Relocated anchor elevation callouts (e.g., CL 120*) outward along the longitudinal tendon vector away from the span (shifted left on left ends, right on right ends, up on top ends, down on bottom ends). Completely avoids collisions with first/last chair dimension lines.
• Persistent Settings & Template Preservations: Fixed settings rollback issue by ensuring all parameters in SettingsView auto-commit to AppData Roaming on input focus loss and application shutdown via WM_DELETE_WINDOW. Settings and template blocks are permanently preserved across updates.
• Robust Update Links: Ensured cloud update manifest and GitHub release endpoints consistently provide exact direct installer URLs without 404 errors.
